paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: : Ratio of clipped signals.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the clip ratio over steps, comparing three different policy strategies. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 480 with tick intervals of 20, indicating discrete steps. The y-axis, ranging from -0.10 to 0.20, is marked in increments of 0.01 and represents the clip ratio in percentage. The dark gray line represents the “On-policy” strategy, exhibiting a relatively consistent value near 0.12 throughout the plotted range, fluctuating between approximately 0.08 and 0.16. The red line depicts the “On-policy w/ Shaping” strategy, characterized by a fluctuating value ranging from approximately -0.05 to 0.13, with multiple peaks and valleys. Finally, the blue line represents the “Mixed-policy w/ Shaping” strategy, showing a value fluctuating between approximately -0.08 and 0.09, consistently lower than the other two lines.
